response.original_title: The First Steps To Salvation Is Forgiveness
response.overview: Centered on the theme that the first step to salvation is forgiveness, this Saint Patrick's College student film follows a young Marist student enduring relentlessly bullied during school hours.  Pushed to his limits, he takes action and calls upon school authorities. When the bullies are confronted with the true values of respect and pride, both must choose between being trapped in conflict, or the difficult path towards reconciliation.
response.title: The First Steps To Salvation Is Forgiveness
